create_OneHotCategorical_with_logits: create a OneHotCategorical distribution initialized with logits for multi-class sampling
sample_OneHotCategorical: sample one-hot encoded categorical values from a OneHotCategorical distribution using a PRNG key
compute_log_prob_OneHotCategorical: compute the log probability of a one-hot encoded value under a OneHotCategorical distribution
compute_mode_OneHotCategorical: compute the mode of a OneHotCategorical distribution as a one-hot encoded array
index_OneHotCategorical: index into a OneHotCategorical distribution to get a sliced distribution for a subset of batch entries
